method: Four independent fresh-browser arms, 108 loads each (12 cycles of 9). Actual confirmed slot loads for game arms; validated checkpoints, not narrative playthrough. Fixed viewport vs original periodic 768/1440 resize vs same-town reload; decode-only native-image control uses the first arm live image sets with no game/canvas. No allocation/CPU profiler attached. Forced GC and live-object queries at checkpoints outside loading; whole-browser Linux PSS, not game-only RAM or a phone budget. 30 seconds natural idle precedes diagnostic critical pressure; forced reclamation is not acceptance.
